lessons.title: Opening: first four chords
lessons.summary: First 4 bars, chords only. LH root + prescribed RH chord.

instructions.text: Shape preparation: play the opening major ii–V–I plus Cmaj7 printed below without metronome. Place each chord carefully. Repeat the sequence 3 times.
Timed progression: metronome 50. Four beats per chord. Play the printed progression 6 times. Do not choose alternate inversions.
Movement observation: play the sequence slowly once. On every change, notice which RH notes stay on the same piano keys. Do not calculate inversion names.
Autumn Leaves: Work only on the first 4 bars of your chart. Play chords only: LH root + RH chord. No melody.
Hand separation: use today's numbered stage below.

handSeparation.base: 50 bpm · LH quarters: C – G – A – G | F – C – F – G · RH quarters: E – G – C – G | A – G – F – D
handSeparation.text: Minute 1 LH only. Minute 2 RH only. Minutes 3–5 both hands together, one note in each hand per beat. Think vertically: C+E, G+G, A+C, G+G, F+A, C+G, F+F, G+D.

Autumn Leaves: Work only on the first 4 bars. Play chords only. Try to look at the chord symbol before looking at the voicing table; if the hand shape does not come immediately, look.
Hand separation: use today's numbered stage below.

instructions.text: Shape preparation: play the complete opening progression printed below without metronome. Place each chord carefully. Repeat the sequence 3 times.

lessons.title: Minor ii–V–i
lessons.summary: First 16 bars, chords only. Focus F♯m7♭5 → B7 → Em.

instructions.text: Place each printed chord carefully without metronome. Repeat the sequence 3 times.
Metronome 50. Four beats per chord. Repeat the printed sequence 6 times.
Play once more and identify common tones by sight: a note that remains on the same key is a common tone. No inversion calculation.
Autumn Leaves: Work on the first 16 bars. Chords only.
Hand separation: use today's stage below.

handSeparation.base: 50 bpm · LH quarters: C – G – A – G | F – C – F – G · RH quarters: E – G – C – G | A – G – F – D
handSeparation.text: Same as Stage 2. Do not increase tempo. Your only goal is to complete the 8-beat pattern without the LH copying the RH rhythm.

lessons.title: Guide tones
lessons.summary: First 8 bars using LH root + RH guide tones.

instructions.text: Play the basic opening progression once from the Week 1 shapes.
Play the guide-tone table 6 times. LH root + the two printed RH notes.
Cover the RH column and attempt the sequence once. If you hesitate more than about 3 seconds, uncover it immediately.
Autumn Leaves: First 8 bars: chords only, using guide tones.
Hand separation: use today's stage below.

handSeparation.base: 50 bpm · LH quarters: C – G – A – G | F – C – F – G · RH quarters: E – G – C – G | A – G – F – D
handSeparation.text: LH continues the same quarter-note pattern. RH plays the original quarter-note melody for one pass, then the eighth-note-pair version for one pass. Alternate for five minutes.

programGuidance.tempo: Weeks 1–2: 50 bpm. Weeks 3–4: 60 bpm unless that prevents continuous playing. Slower is always allowed.
programGuidance.rule: Do not stop during tune practice to generate and compare inversions. Use the prescribed shape when you know it. Otherwise use a simple root-position chord, shell, or LH root and continue.
programGuidance.hands: In voicing drills, LH plays the printed single root. RH plays every printed RH note simultaneously, listed low to high. Root duplication is intentional.
